decisions.reason: The superfood drink mix builds on an established consumer line and costs little to keep listed, but it is peripheral to the firm's announced industrial technology direction, so dropping it would require little justification.

Modular waste-to-energy extensions are central to the firm's announced core direction and carry substantial engineering investment, so management would attribute slow uptake to long industrial sales cycles.
The waste-oil-to-energy plant has its own dedicated web page, signalling visible public commitment and heavy investment that management would be reluctant to write off after only one year.

The plastic-waste-to-fuel plant fits the firm's flagship sustainability narrative and required prototyping investment, so weak early results would be blamed on temporary market and regulatory factors.
